# Preamble

```{r preamble}
#| label: preamble

#----------------------------
# clean environment
#----------------------------
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
library(here)
here()
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
```

# Read in the data

```{r}
#| label: read data

#---------------------------------
# load the formatted MBA data
# for WASH Benefits Bangladesh, 
# created by
# 5-seropositivity_cutoffs.Qmd
#
# data are in long format
# by child-visit-antigen
#---------------------------------
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_pathogen_2026-01-29.rds")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tr))
#-------------------------------
# report the number of kids and
# samples
#-------------------------------
cat("\n\nTHE DATA INCLUDE", nrow(d1), "SAMPLES FROM",length(unique(d1$childid)),"CHILDREN\n")

#-------------------------------
# report the number of clusters
#-------------------------------
cat("\n\nTHE DATA INCLUDE",length(unique(d1$clusterid)), "CLUSTERS\n")

```

# Table 1: Number of clusters by treatment arm

```{r}

#| label: Create the table for number of clusters by treatment arm

d2 <- d1 %>%
  distinct(clusterid,.keep_all = TRUE)

d2_tmp <- d2 %>%
  mutate(clus_dummy = factor("Observations"))  # same level for all rows

tab1 <- table1(
  ~ clus_dummy | tr,
  data = d2_tmp,
  overall = FALSE,
  rowlabelhead = "Arm",
  # summarize categorical by N only
  render.categorical = function(x) c("N" = sum(!is.na(x))),
  topclass = "Rtable1-grid Rtable1-shade Rtable1-times Rtable1-row"
)

tab1


```

# Table 2: Number of clusters and children by treatment arm per visit

```{r}

#| label: Create the table for number of clusters by treatment arm per visit

d2_2 <- d1 %>%
  distinct(clusterid, visit, .keep_all = TRUE)
d2_tmp_2 <- d2_2 %>%
  mutate(clus_dummy = factor("Observations"))  # same level for all rows

tab2 <- table1(
  ~ clus_dummy | tr + visit,
  data = d2_tmp_2,
  overall = FALSE,
  rowlabelhead = "Arm",
  # summarize categorical by N only
  render.categorical = function(x) c("N" = sum(!is.na(x))),
  topclass = "Rtable1-grid Rtable1-shade Rtable1-times Rtable1-row"
)

tab2

```

```{r}
#| label: Create the table for number of children by treatment arm per visit

d3 <- d1 %>%

d3_tmp <- d3 %>%

tab3 <- table1(
  ~ child_dummy | tr + visit,
  data = d3_tmp,
  overall = FALSE,

  topclass = "Rtable1-grid Rtable1-shade Rtable1-times Rtable1-row"
)

tab3

```
